initial_resource_gate: Fresh empty two-node resource check; no initial thirty-minute delay
checkpoint_scope: Same committed round for both roles; Actor, Critic, Adam, ValueNorm and training position
retention: Commit and validate the next complete paired recovery point before deleting the previous owned recovery point; preserve evaluation milestones and final states
after_external_termination: Retain evidence and wait for both nodes to remain continuously free for at least 1800 seconds before resubmission
